## Checklist

- [ ] `go -C goserver vet ./...` and `go -C goserver test ./...` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if user-visible (`README.md` / `HELP.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]`, `README_AR.md` for user-facing text)
- [ ] No binaries committed (`dist/`, `Beam`, `*.apk/.deb/.AppImage`, `mobile/android/`, `*.desktop` stay gitignored)
- [ ] No secrets (no `.env`, keys, personal paths, real passwords)
- [ ] Single change per PR, small diff, stdlib-first
